text.7:98: Or are the people of the townships then secure from the coming of Our wrath upon them in the daytime while they play?
text.20:59: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high.
text.79:29: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
text.79:46: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
